gen-metal-mania-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and sits its mean line high, a contemporary sans under a heavy, intense heading. Metal Mania, with its bent-paperclip strokes, does the shouting.
gen-modak-archivo: Archivo reads with an editorial air, its curves opening outward instead of curling in, and its x-height commands the line. And Modak, fat and rope-like, brings the fun while the sans keeps things approachable.
gen-modak-fs-asap: Asap sets a readable sans against Modak, its body height nearly matching its capitals. And Modak's puffy, pinch-free strokes feel playful beside that tidy, open-armed text.
gen-modak-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and loose, a wire-thin sans with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Epilogue's slim line is the foil here, making Modak's fat, rounded strokes look even more playful.
gen-modak-fs-fira-sans: Chunky fun up top, then a steady hand below. Fira Sans keeps its s curves wide at both ends and its lowercase large, so Modak's bubbly shapes get a sturdy, uniform-stroke partner.
gen-modak-general-sans: Playful and approachable, Modak lets its big, round lowercase eyes do the talking before General Sans takes over with a smooth, steady line. That gap between puffy display and tidy sans is the whole appeal.
gen-modak-manrope: Bubbly meets bright. Modak's uniform, inflated strokes sit above Manrope, and its wide curve mouths and slim cap-to-lowercase step give the sans-serif a lightness that makes the pairing easy.
gen-modak-satoshi: Fat, friendly letters lead, with Modak's washer-sized lowercase eyes grinning down the line. But Satoshi's soaring x-height and single-width strokes keep the contrast sharp: round and loud above, crisp below.
gen-modak-switzer: Approachable describes Switzer, a Swiss sans-serif with a tall waist line and tubular, wire-like letters. And Modak's fat, round strokes sit above it, while the text below keeps its c tips apart and stays easy to follow.
